full_page.content:
1937, May
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 186 Cont.
May 11 Martha Lewindowski - 35 - double pneumonia - has two small chil- dren and husband.
11 Mrs. Mary Sage - 67 - cerebral hemoraging and speechless since last Thursday. Since Friday becoming rational.
12 Mrs. Ellen Murray of Peterboro, Ont. Ca. - 49 - Stroke 7 yrs. in August - in bed most of that time.
Agnes Edw'ds - 32 - Methodist - fears cancer - has had 9 operations Henry Siebert ... back from Eloise Young man with Commonwealth Pentecost
Page 187 May 13 Mrs. Bertha Waun - 41 - rather hopeless with cancer like tuomer, was in agony when about a month ago, instead of to the Dr. came to Monastery. Is here To-night 75% improved ..... Deo Gr.
Undertaker Healon - cured over phone - phone at 11 P.M.
John Moffett of Philadelphia - very threatening stomach.
16 17 Mary Chabie - 6 - not normal, tho in a way bright and happy, unable to talk more than a few word. Is enrolled To-day (50c) Parents to go back to holy sacraments - They have not been attending Church at all for years.
Tho's Kehrer - 38 - brights & liver
E'd Brennan Sioux City, Iowa - 35 - down from 150 to 130 1bs - strep infection feared. Drs. wonder at his fight for life.
Dominic Simon -19 - has been taking Epil. fits since flu fever in 1918
Page 188 May 19 Frace Sabo - 14 - had flu three yrs. ago and been speechless ever since - trouble with eyes also
Marchold DeRooker - 38 - arthritis
